proposed_rules.trigger: A full-width bar at the very top of the page, above the hero, containing top-level menu labels ('Solutions Business Need Work O...'), present on every sampled page.
proposed_rules.decision: Map to the global nav/header fragment, not page content; exclude from the page's block inventory.
proposed_rules.rationale: Identical content and position across every packet analyzed indicates shared site chrome, not authored page content.

proposed_rules.trigger: A bottom-most sibling zone with a fixed marketing tagline ('The best no-code platform for...') plus a thin separator row.
proposed_rules.decision: Map to the global footer fragment; exclude from page-specific block inventory.
proposed_rules.rationale: Identical content/position on every sampled page = site-wide footer chrome.

proposed_rules.trigger: A template/app preview screenshot immediately followed by a button labeled 'Install Free Template App', recurring on every download-template page (this instance's button lacks the bg:color tag seen elsewhere, a styling variant).
proposed_rules.decision: Combine into ONE 'template-download' block: cell1 = preview image, cell2 = CTA link, regardless of the bg:color styling variant. Rejected alternatives: (a) separate image block + default-content link, (b) treating the untagged-button instance as a different block type.
proposed_rules.rationale: Same reusable component across download pages; the missing bg:color tag is a CSS variant, not a structural difference (per variant-is-css-not-new-block).
